name: 8. 路地の奥の書き割り（やり直し）
prompt:
Painting technique: painterly digital oil-paint concept art for a game background. Visible thick brushstrokes, rich color, strong light-and-shadow contrast. Not a classical old-master painting, not a photograph, not anime line art.

World: the back town of an empire's capital, a chaotic slum and pleasure quarter like the Kowloon Walled City: stacked and patched buildings, iron scaffolding, tangled cables and pipes. Magitech everywhere (magic fused with over-advanced technology): neon magic-circle signs, rune circuits glowing along pipes, lamps that mix crystals and brass machinery, projected vision screens showing abstract shapes. Colors: dark violet, iron and brass, with neon in violet, green, cyan and pink, and a few warm windows. Not medieval, not a modern city, not a Japanese Showa-era alley. No paper lanterns.

Attachment 2 is the first finished piece of this set. Match its painting technique, colors, brightness and amount of detail exactly.

This piece is DIFFERENT from the wall pieces: each of the two tall shapes is a narrow view DEEP INTO an alley, with real depth and perspective inside it (do not paint a wall, a door or a panel here). Left view: a narrow alley between dark stacked buildings leads far away; at its end, part of a giant ring-shaped gate blazes with violet power, violet mist and light spilling toward the viewer; the pink frame in the blockout is the glowing ring of the gate, the dark inner area is its dark heart. This is the brightest spot of the whole set. Right view: a narrow gap between dark buildings showing distant tower silhouettes with a few faint windows against a dim violet sky. Keep the outer outline of each view and the pure magenta (#FF00FF) around them exactly as in attachment 1. Output the same size as attachment 1.

Signs and screens show only abstract symbols and shapes, never readable letters. Do not draw any people, UI or text.

name: 13. 屋台：結晶と薬瓶
prompt:
Painting technique: painterly digital oil-paint concept art for a game background. Visible thick brushstrokes, rich color, strong light-and-shadow contrast. Not a classical old-master painting, not a photograph, not anime line art.

Colors: dark violet, iron and brass, with neon in violet, green, cyan and pink, and a few warm windows. Not medieval, not a modern city, not a Japanese Showa-era alley. No paper lanterns.

View: a flat front elevation facing the viewer straight on. No perspective, no vanishing point. Vertical lines stay vertical, horizontal lines stay horizontal. Anything that sticks out (awnings, counters, tanks) is painted flat on the surface, with its depth shown only by shading and cast shadow.

Attachment 1 is a flat-color blockout. Keep the position, outline and size of every shape exactly as it is, and paint over it. Keep the magenta (#FF00FF) areas pure flat magenta: paint nothing there, no glow, no smoke, no shadow spilling into it. Output exactly the same size as attachment 1.

Attachment 2 is the first finished piece of this set. Match its painting technique, colors, brightness and amount of detail exactly.

This piece: a freestanding market stall of the back town, seen straight from the front (about 2.5 m wide, 3.5 m high). Blockout colors: the violet trapezoid = a cloth canopy with a scalloped valance, patched and stained; the thin brown posts = wooden poles wrapped with brass bands; the dark back = a hanging back cloth; the shelf lines = wooden shelves; the small colored blocks = glowing crystals and potion bottles (soft glow, kept inside each object); the lower brown block = the front counter, wood with brass corners and a cloth with an abstract pattern. Hang one small pendant lamp (brass and crystal) under the canopy. No vendor and no people: leave the space behind the counter empty.

Lighting: 60 to 70 percent of the image is in deep shadow. Dense detail is grouped and sits in the shadows at low contrast.

Signs and screens show only abstract symbols and shapes, never readable letters. Do not draw any people, UI or text.
